company.name: NOWFIT Sports Nutrition Sagl
company.distributes: Protein bars, keto wafer cookies and protein snacks from other brands (Pro Nutrition, Ethic Sport) alongside sports nutrition
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop, direct sales at its Viganello (Lugano) office and warehouse by appointment, and gyms, fitness centres, food stores, shopping centres and vending operators
company.sf_brands_carried: Keto wafer cookies and high protein bars from Pro Nutrition and Ethic Sport
what_they_do_well: Sells from its Lugano warehouse to shoppers and to gyms, food stores, shopping centres and vending operators, with sales offices in Wallisellen and Meyrin.
company.fit_rationale: A Lugano-based sports nutrition retailer that already sells bars and wafer cookies from other brands to health-conscious shoppers, and also supplies gyms, food stores and vending operators. Diablo's bars, wafers and cookies match that shelf. It holds stock at its Viganello warehouse.

company.name: Vitaminplus (Welldro AG)
company.distributes: Protein bars (Sponser, Lifefood) and a healthy snacks section alongside vitamins and natural food
company.channels_supplied: Its online shop with druggist advice, and the Welldro drugstores
company.sf_brands_carried: Lifefood raw bars and Sponser protein bars
company.fit_rationale: The online shop of the Welldro drugstores, with a healthy snacks section and bars from outside brands. Diablo's bars and snacks fit its health-conscious shoppers. Tier 3 because food is a small shelf in a mostly supplements range and the drugstore count is not stated on its website.
